verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents adding tracing in minutes via environment variables, SDKs (Python, TS, Go, Java), the `wrap_openai` wrapper, framework integrations, a gateway that traces every call, and OpenTelemetry ingestion. Latency and token usage appear as tracked metrics in alerts and prebuilt dashboards. Hands-on community comments confirm inspecting the inputs and outputs of each step in full traces. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly showing per-call latency and token-count fields on an individual trace (current evidence shows these mainly as aggregate dashboard and alert metrics).
